text:
Zoe: Quick sync: need one final pattern for form validation and delete confirmations. Three items: inline vs summary, required markers, and delete UX. Keep replies short.

Nora: Inline-first for most forms. Use top-summary only when submit returns multiple errors or the form is long (>8 inputs).

Evan: Timing: format checks on blur, presence checks on submit. Inline messages should be concise and show an example value.

Sam: Accessibility: '*' alone is ambiguous. If we show '*', include an sr-only 'Required' span and aria-required on the input. Don't use color alone.

Olivia: UI compromise: hide visible 'Required' helper in dense forms; keep sr-only. Show visible 'Required' in onboarding or long flows where we need clarity.

Nora: Delete rules: single-item -> soft delete + undo snackbar. Bulk -> snackbar with count and scope; permanent -> modal with typed confirm (resource name).

Evan: Edge-case: slow networks can remove the snackbar before users see it. Keep a Trash/activity log for 30 days as a fallback.

Sam: A11y checklist to include in doc: inline errors -> aria-invalid + role=alert; top summary -> role=alert with anchor links; required -> aria-required + sr-only; typed confirm -> clear label about permanence.

design-bot: Created task "forms/patterns/validation-and-delete" -> /design-system/issues/711.

Zoe: Action items: Nora to draft the pattern doc with code snippets, Olivia to add a11y snippets, Sam to write microcopy variants. Target: PR by end of week.

Olivia: I'll add SR examples and contrast notes.

Evan: I'll draft the server error payload spec for anchors.
